# Содержимое файла graph.ts {#sec-api-graph .appendix}

``` python
import { createDb, getQuery } from "../../db/queryDb";
import {Response, Request} from 'express'
import { FilterViewType, RequestConnectionInfoParamsType } from "../../types/connections";

function formatLabelView(ts: number, view: FilterViewType) {
    const d = new Date(ts * 1000);
    switch (view) {
        case 'hour':
        case '6hour':
        case '12hour': {
            const h = d.getUTCHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
            const m = d.getUTCMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
            return `${h}:${m}`;
        }
        case 'day': {
            return `${d.getUTCHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:00`;
        }
        case 'week': {
            const days = ['ПН', 'ВТ', 'СР', 'ЧТ', 'ПТ', 'СБ', 'ВС'];
            return days[(d.getUTCDay() + 6) % 7];
        }
        case 'month': {
            return d.getUTCDate().toString().padStart(2, '0');
        }
        default: return '';
    }
}

function formatLabelCustom(ts: number, bucketSize: number) {
    const d = new Date(ts * 1000);
    if (bucketSize < 3600) {
        const h = d.getUTCHours().toString().padStart(2, '0');
        const m = d.getUTCMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
        return `${h}:${m}`;
    } else if (bucketSize === 3600) {
        return `${d.getUTCHours().toString().padStart(2, '0')}:00`;
    } else {
        return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10); // YYYY-MM-DD
    }
}

function generateTitle(view: FilterViewType, startUnix: number, endUnix: number) {
    const start = new Date(startUnix * 1000);
    const end = new Date(endUnix * 1000);

    const pad = (n: number) => n.toString().padStart(2, '0');
    const fmtTime = (d: Date) => `${pad(d.getUTCHours())}:${pad(d.getUTCMinutes())}`;
    const fmtDate = (d: Date) => `${pad(d.getUTCDate())}.${pad(d.getUTCMonth() + 1)}.${d.getUTCFullYear()}`;

    const monthNames = [
        'Январь', 'Февраль', 'Март', 'Апрель', 'Май', 'Июнь',
        'Июль', 'Август', 'Сентябрь', 'Октябрь', 'Ноябрь', 'Декабрь'
    ];

    switch (view) {
        case 'hour':
            return `С ${fmtTime(start)} до ${fmtTime(end)} ${fmtDate(start)}`;
        case '6hour':
            return `С ${fmtTime(start)} до ${fmtTime(end)} ${fmtDate(start)}`;
        case '12hour':
            return `С ${fmtTime(start)} до ${fmtTime(end)} ${fmtDate(start)}`;
        case 'day':
            return fmtDate(start);
        case 'week': {
            const endOfWeek = new Date(endUnix * 1000 - 1000);
            return `Неделя ${fmtDate(start)} – ${fmtDate(endOfWeek)}`;
        }
        case 'month': {
            const year = start.getUTCFullYear();
            const month = monthNames[start.getUTCMonth()];
            return `${month} ${year}`;
        }
        case 'custom': {
            const diffSec = endUnix - startUnix;
            if (diffSec <= 86400 && start.getUTCDate() === end.getUTCDate()) {
                return `С ${fmtTime(start)} до ${fmtTime(end)} ${fmtDate(start)}`;
            } else {
                return `С ${fmtDate(start)} ${fmtTime(start)} до ${fmtDate(end)} ${fmtTime(end)}`;
            }
        }
        default:
            return '';
    }
}

const aggregate = (
    rows: any[], 
    bucketList: {
        ts: number;
        label: string;
        value: number;
    }[], 
    bucketSize: number
) => {
    const result = bucketList.map(b => ({ ...b }));
    const map = new Map(result.map(b => [b.ts, b]));
    for (const row of rows) {
        const key = Math.floor(row.ts / bucketSize) * bucketSize;
        const entry = map.get(key);
        if (entry) {
            entry.value += row.bytes;
        }
    }
    return result;
};

const getConnectionInfo = async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const {
        clientId,
        selectedView,
        timeStart,
        timeEnd,
        offset,
        dateNow
    }: RequestConnectionInfoParamsType = req.body;
    
    const db = createDb(res)

    try {
        const ipResponse = await getQuery<{ipAddr: string}>(
            db,
            'SELECT ip_addr as ipAddr FROM vpn_users WHERE id = ?',
            [clientId]
        )

        const clientIp: undefined | string = ipResponse[0]?.ipAddr
        const nowSec = new Date(dateNow)
        const off = Number(offset) || 0;

        let intervalStart, intervalEnd, bucketSize, buckets;

        if (selectedView === 'custom') {
            intervalStart = timeStart;
            intervalEnd = timeEnd;
            const duration = intervalEnd - intervalStart;
            if (duration <= 3600) bucketSize = 600;
            else if (duration <= 21600) bucketSize = 900;
            else if (duration <= 43200) bucketSize = 1800;
            else if (duration <= 86400) bucketSize = 3600;
            else if (duration <= 7 * 86400) bucketSize = 86400;
            else bucketSize = 86400;

            const start = Math.floor(intervalStart / bucketSize) * bucketSize;
            buckets = [];
            for (let t = start; t < intervalEnd; t += bucketSize) {
                buckets.push({ ts: t, label: formatLabelCustom(t, bucketSize), value: 0 });
            }
        } else {
            const t = nowSec;
            switch (selectedView) {
                case 'hour':
                    intervalStart = Math.floor(t.getTime() / 3600) * 3600 - off * 3600;
                    intervalEnd = intervalStart + 3600;
                    bucketSize = 600;
                    break;
                case '6hour':
                    intervalStart = Math.floor(t.getTime() / 21600) * 21600 - off * 21600;
                    intervalEnd = intervalStart + 21600;
                    bucketSize = 900;
                    break;
                case '12hour':
                    intervalStart = Math.floor(t.getTime() / 43200) * 43200 - off * 43200;
                    intervalEnd = intervalStart + 43200;
                    bucketSize = 1800;
                    break;
                case 'day':
                    intervalStart = Math.floor(t.getTime() / 86400) * 86400 - off * 86400;
                    intervalEnd = intervalStart + 86400;
                    bucketSize = 3600;
                    break;
                case 'week': {
                    const d = new Date(t.getTime() * 1000);
                    const dayOfWeek = d.getUTCDay();
                    const diffToMonday = (dayOfWeek + 6) % 7;
                    const monday = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), d.getUTCDate() - diffToMonday));
                    const weekStart = monday.getTime() / 1000;
                    intervalStart = weekStart - off * 7 * 86400;
                    intervalEnd = intervalStart + 7 * 86400;
                    bucketSize = 86400;
                    break;
                }
                case 'month': {
                    const d = new Date(t.getTime() * 1000);
                    const year = d.getUTCFullYear();
                    const month = d.getUTCMonth();
                    const totalMonths = year * 12 + month - off;
                    const targetYear = Math.floor(totalMonths / 12);
                    const targetMonth = totalMonths % 12;
                    const startDate = new Date(Date.UTC(targetYear, targetMonth, 1));
                    intervalStart = startDate.getTime() / 1000;
                    const endDate = new Date(Date.UTC(targetYear, targetMonth + 1, 1));
                    intervalEnd = endDate.getTime() / 1000;
                    bucketSize = 86400;
                    break;
                }
                default:
                    return res.status(400).json({ error: `Неподдерживаемый selectedView: ${selectedView}` });
            }

            buckets = [];
            for (let t = intervalStart; t < intervalEnd; t += bucketSize) {
                buckets.push({ ts: t, label: formatLabelView(t, selectedView), value: 0 });
            }
        }

        const title = generateTitle(selectedView, intervalStart, intervalEnd);

        const [origRows, respRows] = await Promise.all([
            getQuery(
                db,
                `SELECT ts, orig_bytes AS bytes FROM conn WHERE "id.orig_h" = ? AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ?
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ts, resp_bytes AS bytes FROM conn WHERE "id.resp_h" = ? AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ?`,
                [clientIp, intervalStart, intervalEnd, clientIp, intervalStart, intervalEnd]
            ),
            getQuery(
                db,
                `SELECT ts, resp_bytes AS bytes FROM conn WHERE "id.orig_h" = ? AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ?
                UNION ALL
                SELECT ts, orig_bytes AS bytes FROM conn WHERE "id.resp_h" = ? AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ?`,
                [clientIp, intervalStart, intervalEnd, clientIp, intervalStart, intervalEnd]
            ),
            getQuery(
                db,
                `SELECT MAX(bytes) AS max_bytes
                FROM (
                    SELECT resp_bytes AS bytes
                    FROM conn
                    WHERE "id.orig_h" = ? AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ?
                    
                    UNION ALL
                    
                    SELECT orig_bytes AS bytes
                    FROM conn
                    WHERE "id.resp_h" = ? AND ts BETWEEN ? AND ?
                ) AS traffic_data;`,
                [clientIp, intervalStart, intervalEnd, clientIp, intervalStart, intervalEnd]
            )
        ]);

        const respPoints = aggregate(respRows, buckets, bucketSize)
        const origPoints = aggregate(origRows, buckets, bucketSize)

        const sumRespBytes = respPoints.reduce((acc, cur) => {
            return cur.value + acc
        }, 0)
        const sumOrigBytes = origPoints.reduce((acc, cur) => {
            return cur.value + acc
        }, 0)

        return res.json({
            success: true,
            title: title,

            info: {
                resp: {
                    points: respPoints,
                    max: Math.max(...respPoints.map(item => item.value)),
                    min: Math.min(...respPoints.map(item => item.value)),
                    sum: sumRespBytes
                },
                orig: {
                    points: origPoints,
                    max: Math.max(...origPoints.map(item => item.value)),
                    min: Math.min(...origPoints.map(item => item.value)),
                    sum: sumOrigBytes
                }
            }
        });
    } catch (e) {
        return res.json({ success: false, info: e });
    } finally {
        db.close();
    }
}

export default getConnectionInfo
```
